title: The Manor - a text driven adventure with modular expansion looking for validation
author: surfing_samurai

comments.author: GiordyViper
comments.body: Damn this looks well made! Already has many features, including challenges. I died during a boss fight, but i wanna try again with a better weapon🤔

replies.author: surfing_samurai
replies.body:
Thanks! There should be plenty of occasions to retrieve weapons in the Entry Hall, but even with the starter dagger you should be fine.

Let me know if you think there's enough to keep you sticking around - it's difficult for a text Adventure to be FUN, and if by replaying sections It gets Boring, we have a problem :)

comments.author: babybangbangbang
comments.body:
This looks powerful, I am loving it! 
Currently in my second run, I'm enjoying the pace and difficulty.

One note: I am noticing the font size to be a bit small sometimes... I would suggest increasing it, but maybe I'll get used to it...

replies.author: surfing_samurai
replies.body: Thanks! You can increase the font size from the drawer menu on the right of you want
